meta.description: Registry for reconstruction failure modes in Phase 2 of the Mono-Process Formal Law Program.

failure_modes.name: reconstruction_aliasing
failure_modes.description: Distinct formal preimages map to indistinguishable observed structures under current constraints.

failure_modes.name: equivalence_class_collapse
failure_modes.description: Inappropriate merging of distinct preimages into a single equivalence class.

failure_modes.name: orientation_reconstruction_conflict
failure_modes.description: Orientation constraints contradict admissibility or residue requirements during inversion.

failure_modes.name: transport_induced_ambiguity
failure_modes.description: Non-local transport history erases markers required for unique preimage identification.

failure_modes.name: branch_reconstruction_explosion
failure_modes.description: Unconstrained branching leads to a non-summable number of candidate preimages.

failure_modes.name: non_invertible_projection
failure_modes.description: The forward projection maps states to a domain where inversion is formally impossible.

failure_modes.name: residue_memory_conflict
failure_modes.description: Historical residue requirements conflict with current process state during reconstruction.

failure_modes.name: constraint_under_specification
failure_modes.description: Insufficient constraints provided to reduce reconstruction ambiguity to a stable level.
